work.summary: Overseas Recommendation Department · AI Innovation Algorithms Group
highlights: Researched and developed multi-turn dialogue understanding and query rewriting models for short-video search.
Designed a dialogue-history augmentation module to improve context and user-intent understanding, and explored preference alignment using users' viewing behavior.
